understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, avoid spikes, finish the current BP35 level, and continue until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each level provides 2 attempts with 50 turns each. Movement actions move the player one grid tile when possible, while gravity pulls the player in the current direction and can affect position after actions. Landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level. Clicks can change gravity or interact with the level when available, and undo can reverse the most recent action when supported. The recent movement became ineffective at the boundary or against an obstruction, so target positions must account for reachable tiles.

understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, avoid spikes, finish the current BP35 level, and continue until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each level provides 2 attempts with 50 turns each. Movement actions move the player one grid tile when possible, while gravity pulls the player in the current direction and can affect position after actions. Landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level. Clicks can change gravity or interact with the level when available, and undo can reverse the most recent action when supported. The recent movement became ineffective at the boundary or against an obstruction, so target positions must account for reachable tiles.
